note: Relecture manuelle (lot B) : entrées dont l’anglais HnS ne diffère de l’anglais HGSS que par des détails sans effet sur le texte SS FR (orthographe, interjection, article, synonyme, mot retiré). Le texte SS FR est repris tel quel.
msgids:
That man's always with his
PSYDUCK.\pSays he wants a POKéMON that
can SURF and dance.\pIs he trying to make a POKéMON
that stars in synchronized\lswimming?

Have you heard of the TIN TOWER
in ECRUTEAK?\pThere are what they call Clear Bells
on top of the tower.\pThey don't make a single noise
in strong winds.\pThere is only one way to make them
ring.\pIt is to obtain another CLEAR BELL
just like the ones at the top of the\ltower.\pI went after it when I was young.
But I never got one...
WROOOOAR! IT'S ROAR!\pEVEN POKéMON RUN FROM A GOOD\nROAR!

Me oh my... Is that you, {PLAYER}?
Fancy meeting you here!\pTo tell the truth... my sandals are
frozen on the ice, and I am stuck.\pIn other words, my flip-flops are
quick-frozen to the ground.\pTee hee.\pWell, it's no laughing matter.\pWould you come around and push
my back?

Me oh my... Is that you, {PLAYER}?
Fancy meeting you here!\pTo tell the truth... my sandals are
frozen on the ice, and I am stuck.\pIn other words, my flip-flops are
quick-frozen with the ground.\pTee hee.\pWell, it's no laughing matter.
Would you push my back?

EUSINE: {PLAYER}! Not again!
I'll be there first next time!\pHaving followed it here, I'm
starting to understand what SUICUNE\lis after.\pTo be honest, I would like to keep
this information to myself.\pBut I want to be an honest trainer
in front of SUICUNE!\pThat's why I am sharing a clue with
you.\pIt seems that...
SUICUNE prefers a hilly place...\lNear water...\lSomewhere north...\pI don't know exactly where yet.
It will just be you and me!\pWho'll find it first?
I challenge you!

…I haven't given up on becoming the
greatest trainer…\pI'm going to find out why I can't
win and become stronger…\pWhen I do, I will challenge you.\pAnd I'll beat you down with all my
power.\p…Humph! You keep at it until then.
MISTY is about the only person in\ntown who can beat the trainers at\lCERULEAN's CAPE.

{PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pSorry to have kept you waiting.
We've finally opened the\lSAFARI ZONE!\pDo you know where it is?\pYou know the GATE inside the cavern
in CIANWOOD CITY?\pIf you go through there and walk for
a short while, you should soon see\lthe SAFARI ZONE!\pWe're a little out of the way, but
please come visit!

Hm? Who are you?\p{PLAYER}, eh? You want me to make
some BALLS?\pSorry, but that'll have to wait.\pDo you know TEAM ROCKET?
Ah, don't worry.\pI'll tell you anyhow.\pTEAM ROCKET's an evil gang that
uses POKéMON for their dirty work.\pThey're supposed to have disbanded
three years ago.\pAnyway, they're at the WELL,
cutting off SLOWPOKETAILS to sell!\pSo I'm going to go give them a
lesson in pain!\pHang on, SLOWPOKE! Old KURT
is on his way!

Apparently, there is an odd tree
on ROUTE 36.\pThey say it dances when you water
it...\pOh, that's a PLAINBADGE from
the GOLDENROD GYM!\pDid you defeat WHITNEY?!\pWell, then there's nothing to worry
about, is there?\pI'll let you use this SQUIRTBOTTLE
for a while then.\l...\pOh, never mind. Keep it!

Fwahahahaha!\pI am KOGA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI live in shadows, a ninja!\pMy intricate style will confound
and destroy you!\pConfusion, sleep, poison…\pPrepare to be the victim of my
sinister technique!\pFwahahahaha!\pPOKéMON is not merely about brute
force--you shall see soon enough!
Soon I'm going to get permission\nfrom our MASTER to use dragons.\pWhen I do, I'm going to become an\nadmirable dragon trainer and gain\lour MASTER's approval.
KURT's LURE BALL is the best for\ncatching hooked POKéMON.\pIt's much more effective than a\nULTRA BALL.

{RIVAL}: You were watching me,
{PLAYER}...\pYeah, that's right!\pI never thought defeating five
KIMONO GIRLS would be so hard...\pI got beaten to a pulp...\p...\pYou must have come here for the
same reason, right?\pDon't get cocky just because you
defeated TEAM ROCKET!\pThese KIMONO GIRLS are insanely
strong.\pSee if you can defeat them.\pBut I'm not going back, I don't
want to see you win.
The password to the boss' room\nis SLOWPOKETAIL.\pBut it's useless unless you have\ntwo passwords.
{STR_VAR_1} seems to want to touch\nthe machines!
{STR_VAR_1} is listening to the\nsound of the machines.
INDIGO PLATEAU\pThe ultimate goal of TRAINERS!\nPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ
Oops! I have an important mission!\nIf they find out I was wasting\ltime here, they'll make me start\lover as the lowest ROCKET GRUNT!\pI better leave now!

Oh! You've managed to get a
CLEAR BELL?\pThe old-time dream of mine...
I see...\pYou've done it...
...\l...I can hear it!\pThe chime of the bells on the wind
coming from the direction of the\lTIN TOWER...
BLACK-GLASSES ups the power of\nDARK-type moves.
Gaah! Life is even tougher!
…I couldn't win…\pI gave it every-thing I had…\pWhat you possess, and what I lack…\pI'm beginning to understand what\nthat dragon master said to me…

{PLAYER}…\pThe journey to becoming the
POKéMON MASTER is long and\ldifficult.\pKnowing that, will you keep
going?\p…\pI see. No, you're right.\pIf you would give up that easily,
you would have never chased that\ldream in the first place.\pI look forward to seeing you
again!
Gaah! I lost! That makes me mad!
This is the sea, as you can see.\pSome POKéMON are found only in\nin water.

Dark roads are dangerous
at night.\pBut in the pitch-black of
night, the sea is even more\ltreacherous!\pWithout the beacon of the
LIGHTHOUSE to guide it,\lno ship can sail.
You know, night time is fun in its\nown ways.\pBut don't overdo it, OK?
Go wherever you'd like! Get lost!\nSee if I care!
My brother made the PC POKéMON\nstorage system.\pI was going to give you BILL's\nnumber…
Our EXECUTIVES are trying to take\nthis place over.\pThey have some big plan. I wonder\nwhat that is?
Hm… You've got many GYM BADGES.
Once while I was battling, my\nPOKéMON couldn't make any moves.\pThe POWER POINTS, or PP, of its\nmoves were all gone.
That's the CUT HM.\nTeach that to a POKéMON to clear\lsmall trees.\pOf course, you have to have the\nGYM BADGE from AZALEA to use it.
You remember me from VIOLET CITY?\nYou must be imagining.\pAnyway, will you show me how to\nget out of this forest?

LANCE: It's been a long time since I
last came here.\pThis is where we honor the LEAGUE
CHAMPIONS for all eternity.\pTheir courageous POKéMON are also
inducted.\pHere today, we witnessed the rise
of a new LEAGUE CHAMPION--a\ptrainer who feels compassion for,
and trust toward, all POKéMON.\pA trainer who succeeded through
perseverance and determination.\pThe new LEAGUE CHAMPION who has
all the makings of greatness!\p{PLAYER}, allow me to register you
and your partners as CHAMPIONS!
Geological features don't appear\nto change.\pBut they actually change, little\nby little.

TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON have pros and cons
depending on their types.\pIf their types differ, a higher-
level POKéMON may lose in battle.\pLearn which types are strong and
weak against your POKéMON's type.

KIMONO GIRL: That's right.\nThis is where we welcome LUGIA.\pWhen the dance we practiced many\ndays becomes one with the sound of the\lTidal Bell we entrusted to you, then\lLUGIA shall come out from deep within\lthe waterfall basin once again.
Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.
You may trade your POKéMON here\nwith another TRAINER.
Why?\nWhy'd I lose?
What is this notice?\pPlease battle only in the grass.\pNATIONAL PARK WARDEN'S OFFICE
Did you come to get KURT to make\nsome BALLS?\pA lot of people do just that.
There's no cheating in POKéMON.\pLet's keep it fair and square!
We bake lots of goodies and share\nthem all around.\pThey're delicious!
What should I make my POKéMON hold?\pMaybe an item that increases\nATTACK power…
Do you know about baby\nPOKéMON?\pI bet they're just adorable!
If it's light, a cave isn't scary.\pIf you're strong, POKéMON aren't\nscary.
We need the money,\nbut selling SLOWPOKETAILS?\pIt's tough being a ROCKET GRUNT!
Hm? This is no place\nfor playing.

LANCE: That odd signal has
finally stopped.\pThe LAKE should be back to
normal.\pYou're the hero! Let me thank
you on behalf of all the\lPOKéMON.\pOh, yes. You should take this.
I found it here, but I don't\lhave any need for it.
I got wiped out on the last\nmission by a kid too.\pWhen we were abducting POKéMON,\nthis kid with long red hair and\lmean-looking eyes just\lcreamed me…
This is a POKéMON MART.\pThey sell BALLS for catching wild\nPOKéMON and other useful items.
I heard about a craftsman who\nmakes custom BALLS in the JOHTO\ltown of AZALEA.\pI wish I had some.
My big brother BILL made the PC\nPOKéMON storage system.

Do you know the benefits
of HIVEBADGE?\pIf you have it, POKéMON up
to L30 will obey you,\leven traded ones.\pPOKéMON that know CUT will be able
to use it outside of battle too.\pHere, I also want you to
have this.
Reckless driving causes accidents!\nTake it easy!
TRAINER TIPS\pLook! Right there, at the left\nside of the post.
The SHRINE ahead is home to the\nMASTER of our dragon-user clan.\pYou're not allowed to just go in!
{RIVAL}: You told me...\nyou were the number one in the whole\lworld!\pAre you gonna quit?\pWhat are you going to do now?

POKéMON have many experiences
in their lives, just like we do.\pI, too, have seen and suffered
much in my life.\pSince I am your elder, let me
show you what I mean.\pI have been with POKéMON since
before you were born.\pI do not lose easily.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
shall demonstrate my power!
Ah, I am impressed by your\nprowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.\pYou are worthy of this BADGE!
…Sway like leaves in the wind…
My SECRET POTION is a tad too\nstrong, so I only offer it in an\lemergency.
POKéMON can hold items like\nPOTION and ANTIDOTE.\pBut they don't appear to know\nhow to use man-made items.

It nests in horizontal holes warmed by
geothermal heat. Foes who stray too
close can expect to be pounced on
and bitten.

Those who sleep holding one of
Cresselia's feathers are assured of
joyful dreams. It is said to represent
the crescent moon.
If a POKéMON has different colors\nfrom usual, it's more valuable.\pWhat? You mean that's not true?
Oh... Ouch...!\nThis stomachache!\pI wouldn't let this guy act like\nthat if not for this pain...!
Oh... Ouch...!\nThis back pain!\pI wouldn't let this guy act like\nthat if not for this pain...!
Big sisters! I just saw the\nbig shadow of a POKéMON over\lthe TIN TOWER!\pIt could be...
…Humph! Useless POKéMON!\pListen, you. You only won because\nmy POKéMON were weak.
Eatathon Contest! No time limit!\pA battle without end! The biggest\nmuncher gets it all for free!
Heheh. Feeling lucky, punk?
SABRINA: Your power…\pIt far exceeds what I foresaw…\pMaybe it isn't possible to fully\npredict what the future holds…\pOK, you win. You earned yourself\nMARSHBADGE.
Oh… Well, if you change your mind,\nplease help us.
Did my eyes deceive me? I saw a\nred GYARADOS in the LAKE…\pBut I thought GYARADOS were\nusually blue?
If a trainer spots another trainer,\nhe has to make a challenge.\pThat is our destiny.
Our city was featured on a radio\nprogram.\pIt's nice to hear praise for your\ncity, but it's a bit embarrassing\ltoo.
The ILEX FOREST is watched\nover by its protector.\pStay out of mischief!
A GYM LEADER isn't just about being\nstrong.\pA LEADER also needs to be\ncompassionate.
I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!
The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came back!\pIts TAIL is growing back too!
I'm training to\nbecome the CHAMP!
{STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a truly impeccable name!\pTake good care of {STR_VAR_1}!

So good of you to come here!\pSPROUT TOWER is a place of
training.\pPeople and POKéMON test their
bonds to build a bright future\ltogether.\pI am the final test.\pAllow me to check the ties
between your POKéMON and you!
Ah! My FARFETCH'D!\pYou found it for us, kid?\pWithout it, we wouldn't be able\nto CUT trees for charcoal.\pThanks, kid!\pNow, how can I thank you…\pI know! Here, take this.

The MASTER BALL is the best!\pIt's the ultimate BALL! It'll
catch any POKéMON without fail.\pIt's given only to recognized
POKéMON researchers.\pI think you can make much better
use of it than I can, {PLAYER}!
This GYM is great.\nI love boarding with my\lPOKéMON!
I have to take so many\ntests, I don't have much\ltime for POKéMON.\pSo when I do get to play,\nI really concentrate.
Yo. How are your POKéMON?\pIf they're weak and not ready\nfor battle, keep out of the grass.
I'm not in favor of overly\npowerful moves.\pI want to win, but I also don't\nwant to harm POKéMON.
You plan to rescue the DIRECTOR?\pThat won't be possible because I'm\ngoing to beat you!
Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.
What?! You made it past our men in\nthe UNDERGROUND?\pHow could you?
{B_EFF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is paralyzed, so it may be unable to move!
{B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s {B_BUFF1} paralyzed {B_EFF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2}, so it may be unable to move!
{B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} boosted the accuracy of its next move using {B_LAST_ITEM}!
What you say if you win a battle
What you say if you lose a battle
Woah! {STR_VAR_1} suddenly hugged\nyou!
Woah! {STR_VAR_1} is suddenly\nplayful!
{STR_VAR_1} is happy skipping about.
Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your team's\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!
Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your PC-boxed\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!
What're you starin' at?

Hm? That SCALE! What's that?
A red GYARADOS?\pThat's rare! I, I want it…\p{PLAYER}, would you care to
trade it?\pI can offer this EXP.SHARE
that I got from PROF.OAK.
My POKéMON are simply darling.\pLet me tell you how proud my\ndarlings make me.
We adore our POKéMON, even if they\ndislike us.\pThat's what being a FAN is about.
Yo, CHAMP in making!\pA trainer as skilled as you\ndoesn't need to be told how to\ldeal with PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,\lright?\pI expect great things from you!\pGood luck!

LANCE: Excellent!\pIt seems that the LAKE's MAGIKARP
are being forced to evolve.\pA mysterious radio broadcast
coming from MAHOGANY is the cause.\pWe'll be waiting for you,
{PLAYER}.
Everyone Welcome!\nFIGHTING DOJO

KIMONO GIRL: That's right.
This is where we welcome HO-OH.\pWhen the dance we practiced many
days becomes one with the sound of the\pCLEAR BELL we entrusted to you, then
HO-OH shall come down from the great\larch of the sky once again.
Speaking of sick, I've heard there's\na good PHARMACY in CIANWOOD.
JASMINE is this city's GYM LEADER.\pI mean to bring her back with me.\pNobody had better get in my way!
I lost?\pAgain?\pI don't believe it. There must\nbe some mistake…
CHERRYGROVE CITY\pThe City of Cute, Fragrant\nFlowers
Fork over your goodies!
WHITNEY: Wow, you did it!\pI thought the answer to the third\nquestion was surely apricorns!\lOops!\pIt's time to go back to the GYM!
BEN is a fabulous DJ.\pHis sweet voice makes me melt!
Aww! There's no games here!\pI wanted to play…
{STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!\pBut, would you like me to give it\na nicer name?\pHow about it?
You're strong.\pYou obviously must have trained\nhard.
I lost?\pAgain?\pI don't believe it. There must be\nsome mistake…
Check out my POKéMON. Just look\nat their coloring and their\lplumage.
DRAGON SHRINE\pA shrine honoring the dragon\nPOKéMON\psaid to have lived in DRAGON'S\nDEN.
RISINGBADGE will enable your\nPOKéMON to use the move for\lclimbing waterfalls.\pAlso, all POKéMON will recognize\nyou as a trainer and obey your\levery command without question.
Whenever I roll into this town,\nI always visit the OLIVINE CAFE.\pEverything on the menu makes me\nfeel stronger. I can't stop eating!
With your skills, you'll do well at\nthe LEAGUE.\pThat's what my premonition says.
We use GHOST-type POKéMON.\pNo NORMAL-type attacks can\nharm them!
Wahahah! You're a feisty one!
The best thing to ever happen to\nme was discovering POKéMON.
I don't believe it! I was beaten!
The trainers of this GYM use ROCK-type\nPOKéMON.\pThe ROCK-type has high DEFENSE.\pBattles could end up going a long time.\nAre you ready for this?
{B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s {B_SCR_ABILITY} raised the power of Fire-type moves!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} switched stat changes with its target!
A bizarre orb that\nbadly poisons the\nholder in battle.
A corkscrewing attack with\nthe beak acting as a drill.

It freely controls three units called
Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
With them, it can attack its foes from
three directions.

Not only are the KIMONO GIRLS
great dancers, they're also\lskilled at POKéMON.\pBut they battle only for good
reasons.\pI don't know if you could beat
them if they showed their skill...
At night, the sea turns black. It\nfeels like it will swallow you up.
MAGIKARP have returned to LAKE\nOF RAGE.\pThat should be good news for the\nanglers there.
The world of POKéMON is deep.\pThere are still lots of things we\ndon't know.\pBut I know more than you do!
{PLAYER}: Hi! Thanks a lot for the\nrail PASS!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic\nmy every move?
There are other graves of POKéMON\nhere, I think.\pThere are many chambers that only\nMR.FUJI may enter.

Strong POKéMON.\pWeak POKéMON.\pThat is only the selfish
perception of people.\pTruly skilled trainers should
try to win with their favorites.\pI like your style. You understand
what's important.\pGo on--the CHAMPION is waiting.
If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.
ERIKA: Losing still leaves a\nbitter aftertaste…\pBut knowing that there are strong\ntrainers spurs me to do better…
I do only one haircut a day.\nI'm done for today.
Man, you are truly tough…\pThat was a heck of an inspirational\nbattle. It brought tears to my eyes.
Kwahaha!\pConfounded by the shutters, are we?\pI'll let you in on a secret if you\ncan beat me!
…sigh… I moved here, but I can't\nsell my BICYCLES. Why is that?\pCould you ride a BICYCLE and\nadvertise for me?
I came through the tunnel,\nbut I still have plenty\lof energy left.
The passengers are all trainers.\pThey're all itching to battle in\ntheir cabins.

I'm BUGSY!\pI never lose when it comes
to bug POKéMON.\pMy research is going to make me the
authority on bug POKéMON!\pLet me demonstrate all I've
learned from my studies.
No?\nThat's too bad.
How could this be?\pOur dreams have come to naught.\pI wasn't up to the task after all.\pLike GIOVANNI did before me, I will\ndisband TEAM ROCKET here today.\pFarewell.
MISTY: You really are good…\pI'll admit that you are skilled…\pHere you go. It's CASCADEBADGE.
Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…
Barrier Station to TIN TOWER\pNo Trespassing by the Unworthy.
...Zzz...\p...Umm... Rest!\pThe phrase 'recover fast' became\nshortened to 'Rest,' you see?\pThis is a move to sleep and recover\nsome HP.
The LAKE hasn't been normal since\nthose men wearing black arrived.
On sunny days, I think that the\nkids would rather be playing in the\lschoolyard than studying in class.
Yo! CHAMP in making! That GYM didn't\ngive you much trouble.\pThe way you took charge was really\ninspiring. I mean that seriously.
A BELLSPROUT over 100 feet\ntall…\pPeople say that it became the\ncenter pillar here.
{B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s {B_LAST_ITEM} snapped it out of its confusion!
Your POKéMON almost slipped and fell\nover!
{STR_VAR_1} is staring at its\nreflection in the water.
Your POKéMON seems happy about the\ngreat weather.
Your POKéMON party is full.\nMake room, then come see me.
Oh, you're so strong!
The tug you feel on the ROD when\nyou hook a POKéMON…\pThat's the best feeling ever for\nan angler like me.
See? Doesn't it look nice?\pGiggle…\nIt's such a cute POKéMON.

When I was walking in the grass, a
bug POKéMON poisoned my POKéMON!\pI just kept going, but then my
POKéMON fainted.\pYou should keep an ANTIDOTE
with you.
I don't believe this!

…Tell me something.\pIs it true that TEAM ROCKET
has returned?\pWhat? You beat them? Hah! Quit
lying.\pYou're not joking?
Then let's see how good you are.
Why?\nHow could I lose?
With that thing, you can tune into\nthe radio programs here in KANTO.\pGahahahaha!
The COPYCAT girl looked unhappy.\pShe said she lost her favorite\nPOKé DOLL--CLEFAIRY.
JANINE: I'm going to really apply\nmyself and improve my skills.\pI want to become better than both\nFather and you!
Yo, CHAMP in making!\pWhoops! Take a good look around you.\pThe trainers all look like the\nLEADER, JANINE.\pWhich of them is the real JANINE?
ERIKA: Oh! I concede defeat…\pYou are remarkably strong…\pI shall give you RAINBOWBADGE…
I'm going to audition my songs\nat GOLDENROD's RADIO STATION.
How the heck do you go up?\pI want to visit the sick POKéMON,\nbut I can't get up there…
Every time I return to OLIVINE,\nI visit the GYM.\pThe GYM LEADER’s POKéMON type\nchanged without me noticing.

exclus.PROF.ELM: Hello, {PLAYER}? We\\ndiscover: le texte SS dit « Boutique Pokémon de Mauville » alors que l’assistant attend au Centre Pokémon de Mauville dans HnS (VioletCity_PokemonCenter_hns)
